messages:
Maya (CS): @here planning a 60m 'Onboard Handshake Roundtable' next week to align hosts for three new cohorts (Acme, Nova, Helix). Goal: host runbooks, one-page playbook handoff, and renewal-risk signals quick-check. Need a slot that works for NAM + EMEA attendees. :wave:

Ajay Patel: +1. Happy to host. My preference is 9:30am PT / 12:30pm ET on Tues/Wed. Works better for customer PMs.

Emily S: I can do Wed or Thu. Prefer midday UTC (13:00 UTC is fine). If we pick 12:30 ET that works for me also.

Tim R: Can we split into two sessions? One targeting APAC hours and one for NAM/EMEA? We have 3 hosts available, might be easier to run regional handoffs.

Maya (CS): Good call. For time constraints I'd like a single NAM/EMEA session first (most renewal-risk signals are there this quarter). APAC follow-up next week.

Ajay Patel: Sounds good. If NAM/EMEA, propose these options:
- Option A: Tue 12:30pm ET / 17:30 UTC
- Option B: Wed 11:00am ET / 16:00 UTC
- Option C: Thu 9:00am ET / 14:00 UTC

Emily S: Option A or B for me. C is tight.

Tim R: Option B is best for my schedule.

Maya (CS): Creating quick poll and calendar hold. Please vote by EOD. Poll includes capacity for 25 attendees, 60m with 10m buffer.

CalendarBot: Poll created: https://calendar.example.com/poll/1717123456

Maya (CS): Draft agenda (60m):
```
1) 5m - Welcome + objectives
2) 10m - Runbook handoff (hosted by Ajay)
3) 15m - Customer onboarding status (each customer 3-4m)
4) 10m - Renewal-risk quick scan (red/yellow/green flags + owner)
5) 15m - Q&A + next steps (assign follow-ups)
```

Ajay Patel: Suggest we add a 5m pre-read: one-pager per customer with rollout status + blockers. I'll draft templates and post to the doc.

Emily S: I'll own the renewal-risk matrix prep for Acme + Nova. Can we slot 5m each for the two highest-risk accounts?

Maya (CS): Yes — adding owners: Acme (Emily), Nova (Ajay), Helix (Tim). We'll surface any data needed from product telemetry.

Tim R: I'll host APAC follow-up. Happy to cover Helix and handoff notes.

Ajay Patel: Quick note — let's capture configuration/infra notes (Dedicated vs Private) in the runbook. Some customers on Dedicated want specific rollout windows.

Maya (CS): Noted. Adding a checklist item. Also tagging #eng-oncall if we need a short infra confirm during the session.

Emily S: +1 on tagging eng-oncall. I might ping them about a perf regression we saw on Nova.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Final ask: vote in the poll (link above) and attach the one-pager to the calendar event when you have it. I'll close the poll tomorrow 3pm PT and publish the invite. :thumbsup:

Ajay Patel: Voted Option B. Will upload template by EOD.

Tim R: Voted Option B.

Emily S: Voted Option A (but can do B if needed).

Maya (CS): Poll closed — majority selected Option B. Creating event for Wed 11:00am ET / 16:00 UTC. Sending invites now.

CalendarBot: Event created: "Onboard Handshake Roundtable — NAM/EMEA" Wed 11:00am ET (https://calendar.example.com/event/1717123456)
